standard_prerequisites.use: Univalence, function extensionality, dependent path transport, higher inductive pushouts/suspensions, truncations and basic pointed homotopy notions. The selected local code, fiber or gluing constructions are retained as author proof. Original numbered references identify these foundations.

core_obligations: Construct a family over a pushout and identify its total space using the Hopf construction of an H-space.
Build the circle H-space structure and join equivalences to identify the total space with the 3-sphere.

difficulty_reason: The retained author construction requires coherent pushout-family gluing, the circle multiplication structure and total-space identification. It is H2; short homotopy-group consequences are not counted.

compared.difference: Flattening is a general prerequisite but does not construct the circle H-space or identify the Hopf total space. This is distinct from Freudenthal connectivity and circle path-space computation.
Hypercubical manifolds concerns a different cubical presentation, not this book claim.
A Whitehead result for test categories has different objects and hypotheses; not this finitely truncated type theorem.
